functions.name: constructor
functions.compact_graph:
[constructor(creationCode: bytes)]
  N1:  creationCodeSize = creationCode.length  [creationCodeSize <- creationCode]
  N2:  creationCodeSizeA = creationCodeSize / 2  [creationCodeSizeA <- creationCodeSize]
  SW:  _creationCodeSizeA = creationCodeSizeA  [state._creationCodeSizeA <- creationCodeSizeA]
  N3:  creationCodeSizeB = creationCodeSize - creationCodeSizeA  [creationCodeSizeB <- creationCodeSizeA, creationCodeSize]
  SW:  _creationCodeSizeB = creationCodeSizeB  [state._creationCodeSizeB <- creationCodeSizeB]
  N4:  creationCodeA = creationCode  [creationCodeA <- creationCode]
  SW:  _creationCodeContractA = CodeDeployer.deploy(creationCodeA)  [state._creationCodeContractA <- creationCodeA]
  N5:  creationCodeB = creationCode + creationCodeSizeA  [creationCodeB <- creationCodeSizeA, creationCode]
  N6:  lastByteA = mload(uint256)(creationCodeB)  [lastByteA <- creationCodeB]
  SW:  _creationCodeContractB = CodeDeployer.deploy(creationCodeB)  [state._creationCodeContractB <- creationCodeB]

functions.name: getCreationCodeContracts
functions.compact_graph:
[getCreationCodeContracts() -> address, address]
  N1:  (_creationCodeContractA,_creationCodeContractB)  [<- _creationCodeContractB, _creationCodeContractA]
  N2:  (contractA,contractB)  [<- contractB, contractA]

functions.name: getCreationCode
_getCreationCodeWithArgs
functions.compact_graph:
[_getCreationCodeWithArgs(constructorArgs: bytes) -> bytes]
  N1:  creationCodeContractA = _creationCodeContractA  [creationCodeContractA <- _creationCodeContractA]
  N2:  creationCodeSizeA = _creationCodeSizeA  [creationCodeSizeA <- _creationCodeSizeA]
  N3:  creationCodeContractB = _creationCodeContractB  [creationCodeContractB <- _creationCodeContractB]
  N4:  creationCodeSizeB = _creationCodeSizeB  [creationCodeSizeB <- _creationCodeSizeB]
  N5:  creationCodeSize = creationCodeSizeA + creationCodeSizeB  [creationCodeSize <- creationCodeSizeB, creationCodeSizeA]
  N6:  constructorArgsSize = constructorArgs.length  [constructorArgsSize <- constructorArgs]
  N7:  codeSize = creationCodeSize + constructorArgsSize  [codeSize <- constructorArgsSize, creationCodeSize]
  N8:  code = mload(uint256)(0x40)  [code]
  N9:  dataStart__getCreationCodeWithArgs_asm_0 = code + 32  [dataStart__getCreationCodeWithArgs_asm_0 <- code]
  N10:  constructorArgsDataPtr = constructorArgs + 32  [constructorArgsDataPtr <- constructorArgs]
  N11:  constructorArgsCodeDataPtr = code + 32 + creationCodeSize  [constructorArgsCodeDataPtr <- code, creationCodeSize]
  N12:  code  [<- code]

functions.name: _create
functions.compact_graph:
[_create(constructorArgs: bytes, salt: bytes32) -> address]
  N1:  creationCode = _getCreationCodeWithArgs(constructorArgs)  [creationCode <- constructorArgs]
  N2:  destination = create2(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256)(0,creationCode + 32,mload(uint256)(creationCode),salt)  [destination <- salt, creationCode]
  IF:  destination == address(0)  [branch: destination]
  N3:  destination  [<- destination]

functions.name: _memcpy
functions.compact_graph:
[_memcpy(dest: uint256, src: uint256, len: uint256)]
  IF:  len >= 32  [branch: len]
  N1:  dest += 32  [dest <- dest]
  N2:  src += 32  [src <- src]
  N3:  len -= 32  [len <- len]
  N4:  mask = 256 ** (32 - len) - 1  [mask <- len]
  N5:  srcpart__memcpy_asm_1 = mload(uint256)(src) & ~ mask  [srcpart__memcpy_asm_1 <- src, mask]
  N6:  destpart__memcpy_asm_1 = mload(uint256)(dest) & mask  [destpart__memcpy_asm_1 <- mask, dest]
